ignoredExports.name: eventAccentColors
ignoredExports.reason: Design-owned token helper documented through the IconChip component entry.

ignoredExports.name: useSnackbar
ignoredExports.reason: Hook documented through the SnackbarProvider component entry.

components.name: AppIcon
components.summary: Design-owned functional icon renderer backed by the approved native icon vocabulary.
useWhen: Rendering any functional or status icon in product UI.
avoidWhen: The image is decorative artwork or an empty-state illustration.
accessibility: Pair functional icons with a labeled control or hide decorative icons from accessibility.

components.name: AppText
components.summary: Tokenized typography primitive with PuppyPlan variants, tones, numeric styling, and Dynamic Type ceilings.
useWhen: Rendering any user-visible text inside product UI.
avoidWhen: A higher-level primitive already owns its label or message.
accessibility: Preserves font scaling through the documented per-variant maximum multipliers.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Tokenized person or puppy identity circle with deterministic placeholder initials and sizes.
useWhen: Showing a puppy, owner, caregiver, sitter, or trainer identity.
avoidWhen: The icon represents an action, tracker, or generic status.
accessibility: Use the identity label, not a generic image description.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Labeled primary, secondary, tertiary, or destructive action with loading and disabled behavior.
useWhen: Triggering an important labeled action or an explicit destructive confirmation.
avoidWhen: The action is icon-only, a list row, or a low-level custom interaction.
accessibility: Owns button role, busy and disabled state, visible-label fallback, and minimum touch target.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Tokenized static or interactive content surface with resting, hero, muted-template, and interactive treatments.
useWhen: Grouping cohesive content that benefits from a raised or interactive surface.
avoidWhen: A simple list row, section, or nested card would communicate the content more directly.
accessibility: Interactive cards require one summarized label and expose button semantics.

components.name: CheckCircle
components.summary: Circular diary completion control for checked and unchecked routine state.
useWhen: Marking or unmarking a routine completion in Diary.
avoidWhen: Representing a general boolean setting; use Toggle instead.
accessibility: Requires a label and exposes checkbox checked/disabled state.

components.name: DayDivider
components.summary: Diary section boundary that labels a day and optional supporting date copy.
useWhen: Separating chronological Diary groups by day.
avoidWhen: Labeling a generic settings or content section.
accessibility: Exposes header semantics so assistive technology can navigate day groups.

components.name: EmptyIllustration
components.summary: Neutral decorative illustration reserved for empty or unavailable content states.
useWhen: An EmptyState needs calm decorative support without a mascot.
avoidWhen: The visual communicates a functional action or status.
accessibility: Keep decorative instances hidden from accessibility.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Empty or unavailable screen explanation with optional primary and secondary next actions.
useWhen: A surface has no content or access and needs one clear recovery or creation action.
avoidWhen: Content is still loading or an inline recoverable error belongs near its field.
accessibility: Keeps decorative illustration separate while the title, body, and actions remain readable.

components.name: FAB
components.summary: Persistent 56pt Quick Log or Add floating action button in the thumb zone.
useWhen: Opening the canonical Quick Log/Add action from primary navigation.
avoidWhen: A screen-local labeled action or secondary toolbar action is needed.
accessibility: Requires explicit label and hint and owns a 56pt minimum target.

components.name: FactCard
components.summary: Diary fact surface for a logged event, time, optional note, sync state, and actions.
useWhen: Rendering an observed or logged event inside Diary.
avoidWhen: Rendering a planned routine; use RoutineCard instead.
accessibility: Requires a summarized event label and keeps overflow actions separately focusable.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Compact icon-only action with plain, filled, or tinted treatment and an explicit accessible label.
useWhen: A familiar icon action must fit compact chrome such as close, back, edit, or overflow.
avoidWhen: A visible text label is important for comprehension or the action is primary.
accessibility: Requires a label and owns button semantics and minimum touch target.

components.name: IconChip
components.summary: Tonal icon container for Diary event categories and quiet past-state presentation.
useWhen: Giving a Diary event a consistent clay, sage, honey, or mauve accent.
avoidWhen: The icon itself is an action or standalone status control.
accessibility: Treat as decorative when adjacent text already communicates the event.

components.name: InfoHero
components.summary: Calm informational hero with optional title and supportive message.
useWhen: A screen needs one calm, high-priority explanatory message.
avoidWhen: The message is an error, action list, or generic nested card.
accessibility: Exposes a single summary group in visual reading order.

components.name: ListGroup
components.summary: Shared rounded container for a visually connected group of ListRow items.
useWhen: Several related ListRow items form one settings or information section.
avoidWhen: Rows are unrelated or need independent card surfaces.
accessibility: Preserves the semantics of child rows rather than becoming one focus target.

components.name: ListRow
components.summary: Structured static or interactive row for settings, health records, and timeline lists.
useWhen: A row needs a title, supporting copy, metadata, leading content, trailing content, or chevron.
avoidWhen: The content is a free-form card or a compact icon-only action.
accessibility: Interactive rows expose one button-like node; static rows preserve child text unless intentionally summarized.

components.name: PendingDot
components.summary: Small tokenized pending-write indicator for data awaiting durable synchronization.
useWhen: A nearby event or row must visibly indicate unsynced state.
avoidWhen: The indicator would be the only explanation of a failed or actionable state.
accessibility: Provide a label when adjacent text does not already explain pending state.

components.name: PuppyHeader
components.summary: Compact puppy identity header with avatar, name, and supporting profile metadata.
useWhen: A surface needs compact current-puppy context.
avoidWhen: The screen already has a full ScreenHeader or profile hero.
accessibility: Keeps the puppy name and metadata in visual reading order; the decorative placeholder does not create a separate identity node.

components.name: RoutineCard
components.summary: Diary planned-routine card with completion control, time metadata, and lifecycle actions.
useWhen: Rendering a planned routine occurrence inside Diary.
avoidWhen: Rendering an observed fact or logged event; use FactCard instead.
accessibility: Separates checkbox and overflow actions while exposing the routine copy as a coherent group.

components.name: RoutineLifecycleMenu
components.summary: Design-owned menu and confirmation surface for editing, pausing, resuming, and deleting a routine.
useWhen: Offering lifecycle actions for an existing planned routine.
avoidWhen: Creating or editing routine fields; use the routine editor flow.
accessibility: Each action remains separately labeled; destructive confirmation is explicit and reversible where supported.

components.name: Screen
components.summary: Design-owned safe-area screen container with scroll-first and fixed presentation modes.
useWhen: Providing the root layout surface for a feature screen.
avoidWhen: A nested section or sheet needs only local spacing.
accessibility: Preserves native scroll behavior and avoids fixed-height assumptions under Dynamic Type.

components.name: ScreenHeader
components.summary: Screen-level title and optional back control with Dynamic Type-safe header anatomy.
useWhen: A routed screen needs a title and optional back navigation.
avoidWhen: A sheet or content section needs its own smaller header.
accessibility: Title exposes header semantics and the back control has an explicit label.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.summary: Compact section heading with optional trailing action or metadata.
useWhen: Labeling a related group of content below the screen title.
avoidWhen: The title represents the entire route or a modal sheet.
accessibility: Exposes header semantics without swallowing trailing control semantics.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Tokenized two-to-four option single-selection control with tab semantics.
useWhen: Switching between a small set of mutually exclusive local modes.
avoidWhen: Navigating between routes or choosing from a long option list.
accessibility: Container exposes tablist semantics; each option exposes selected and disabled state.

components.name: SheetHeader
components.summary: Bottom-sheet or modal title row with an optional accessible close action.
useWhen: A SheetSurface or modal flow needs a clear title and close affordance.
avoidWhen: The title belongs to a full routed screen or content section.
accessibility: Title exposes header semantics and close action requires a localized label.

components.name: SheetSurface
components.summary: Static tokenized sheet or panel surface; it is not a focus-trapping modal implementation.
useWhen: Styling content already presented inside a sheet or panel boundary.
avoidWhen: You need presentation, focus trapping, background isolation, or dismiss gestures.
accessibility: Labels the surface; modal focus ownership remains the responsibility of the presenter.

components.name: SnackbarProvider
components.summary: Design-owned transient message host and hook contract for info, success, warning, error, undo, or retry feedback.
useWhen: Confirming a transient action or offering a short undo/retry action without blocking the flow.
avoidWhen: The message must persist, explain a field error, or block a destructive decision.
accessibility: Messages require a full accessibility label and use polite live-region behavior; actions stay focusable.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: Tokenized vertical layout primitive for consistent gaps and alignment without raw spacing values.
useWhen: Arranging sibling content vertically with a design-token gap.
avoidWhen: The layout needs a specialized grid, overlay, or component-owned anatomy.
accessibility: Does not create an accessibility node; child order remains reading order.

components.name: StatusPill
components.summary: Compact icon-plus-label status treatment that never relies on color alone.
useWhen: Showing a compact named state beside a record or summary.
avoidWhen: The status requires interaction, a long explanation, or urgent automatic red styling.
accessibility: Requires a localized status label and pairs icon with text so meaning is not color-only.

components.name: SwipeToDelete
components.summary: Gesture wrapper that reveals a labeled destructive delete action for list content.
useWhen: A list item supports swipe-to-delete and also has a non-swipe alternative.
avoidWhen: Delete is the only action path or the content is not a list-like row/card.
accessibility: Exposes the revealed delete action as a labeled button; callers must also provide a menu alternative.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: Tokenized text input with linked label, disabled state, and inline error message.
useWhen: Collecting single-line or multiline text through a native text input.
avoidWhen: Choosing dates, times, booleans, or a small closed set of options.
accessibility: Uses the visible label as fallback and exposes invalid/disabled state with adjacent error copy.

components.name: TimeGutter
components.summary: Fixed Diary time column for aligned event time and optional supporting label.
useWhen: Aligning chronological Diary rows against a shared time column.
avoidWhen: Showing time inside a standalone card or form field.
accessibility: Keeps time copy readable without introducing an interactive node.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: Design-owned native boolean switch with tokenized platform treatment.
useWhen: A setting takes effect as a simple on/off value.
avoidWhen: The choice requires confirmation, multiple options, or immediate navigation.
accessibility: Exposes switch role and checked/disabled state; provide a label when row text does not label it.

components.name: Touchable
components.summary: Design-owned low-level press wrapper with mandatory semantics, platform touch targets, and busy/disabled handling.
useWhen: No higher-level design primitive fits a custom interaction.
avoidWhen: Button, IconButton, ListRow, Card, CheckCircle, or TrackerTile already fits.
accessibility: Requires explicit label and role and enforces iOS/default 44pt or Android 48dp targets.

components.name: TrackerTile
components.summary: Large icon-and-label tracker action for Quick Log and tracker selection grids.
useWhen: A user selects or triggers one of the approved Quick Log trackers.
avoidWhen: The action is a generic CTA, settings row, or compact toolbar control.
accessibility: Uses label fallback, button role, selected/disabled state, and large touch anatomy.

components.name: WeekStrip
components.summary: Seven-day Diary date strip with selected-day state and optional day navigation.
useWhen: Choosing or summarizing the visible Diary day within a week.
avoidWhen: Selecting an arbitrary date range or editing an event timestamp.
accessibility: Each selectable day exposes button role, a full date label, and selected state.

components.name: WhenPicker
components.summary: Controlled disclosure row and native picker for choosing when a log event occurred.
useWhen: Quick Log details need a now-or-specific-time choice.
avoidWhen: Selecting a Diary browsing day or recurring schedule rule.
accessibility: Disclosure control exposes expanded state and the native picker remains labeled.
